findings.issue: Task count is 17, above the >15 threshold flagged by tech-spec-planning skill. The skill instructs to propose splitting into MVP + Extension phases when exceeded.
findings.fix: Either acknowledge the threshold explicitly in the document (e.g., in Solution/Phases section) with a justification for keeping 17 tasks together, or split into an MVP (Phase A + B core flip) and Extension (Phase C verification + docs). NOTE: Phase B sub-tasks 3-10 are documented as a single physical commit per D5 — consider explicitly merging them into one logical Task 3 'Atomic flip (8 sub-bullets inside one task)' to bring count under 15 without losing reviewer-navigation detail.

Wave 2 sub-tasks are explicitly review-navigation aids per D5 — that purpose can be served with a shorter scope description plus pointers ('see Architecture section for full call-site list').

findings.fix: Either add `security-auditor` to those three tasks' Reviewers (matching the skill default), or add a brief inline note explaining why security-auditor is intentionally skipped (e.g., 'pure type-signature refactor; no auth/data-handling surface').
